_comment: Baseline strategy. Edit + push to main and Render redeploys. The in-bot strategist adjusts these within bounds every ~4h unless a key is listed in lock. See ctnbot/strategy.py for the allowed keys and ranges.
style_notes: Vary how you open: don't start with 'Fair', 'Fair point' or 'Fair enough' (most of our replies already do, which reads as scripted)
Only mention the unpublished venue list or end date if the person raised it themselves
Never volunteer the No side's talking points (venue list, end date, sunset) in a reply unless the person raised them
Don't lean on the same stock facts every post (30 ICU beds, 40 nursing posts, nurse clinic and a helicopter); use a different detail or a personal moment instead

Replies and follow-ups: 2-3 sentences, 160-300 characters. First sentence answers the exact point they just made (their words, their example); then one concrete detail of your own. Short one-liners read as dismissive; a story that ignores their point reads as a script
In a follow-up, never repeat a point already made in the thread; bring something new
A quarter of our replies repeat 'nothing kicks in until everyone eligible has had a fair chance at the free jab'. Use the phase-in fact only if they raised access, cost or timing, and word it freshly
Don't answer a worry with 'the details get settled in the regulations after a Yes': it concedes their point. Answer the worry directly, then give your own reason
